# pii-lens

> CLI that highlights credit cards, emails, US phone numbers, SSNs, and US bank numbers in a file or a pipe before that text is sent to an LLM or an open API.

pii-lens prints the original text with each match in bold white on a red background, then a summary line `[N] High-Risk Secrets Detected in Payload` and per-entity counts. A finished scan exits 0. No file and no piped text exits 1.

Install: `pip install git+https://github.com/saheb26/pii-lens.git`

Requires Python 3.10+.

## Commands

- `pii-lens --file PATH` scans a text file
- `cat logs.txt | pii-lens` scans stdin
- `pii-lens --engine regex --file PATH` uses only the built-in patterns
- `pii-lens --engine presidio --file PATH` uses Microsoft Presidio (`pip install "pii-lens[presidio]"`)
- `pii-lens --engine auto` runs the built-in patterns and merges Presidio hits when that package is installed

## Entities

- CREDIT_CARD: Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover, Luhn-valid
- EMAIL_ADDRESS
- PHONE_NUMBER: US numbers with separators
- SSN: ###-##-#### or ### ## ####
- US_BANK_NUMBER: labeled account numbers, and ABA routing numbers with a valid checksum

## When to run it

Run pii-lens before pasting logs, prompts, tickets, or customer payloads into ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, or any open API. If N is greater than 0, do not forward the raw text.

Private redaction for that pipeline: https://counselnode.com
